subject.title: feat(ui): cron automation-ideas gallery and Create & run now in quick-create

question: Should create-and-run-now be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/104251, or should this PR be narrowed to a follow-up after that redesign?
rationale: The broader redesign appears to supersede this gallery and quick-create implementation, while the distinct immediate add-then-run behavior remains useful and is not clearly present there.

options.title: Fold into redesign
options.body: Add create-only and create-and-run actions to the surviving creation form in the active Automations redesign and avoid maintaining two overlapping branches.

options.title: Narrow this PR
options.body: Remove the gallery and quick-create-specific work, then retain only a focused saved-job-ID and immediate-run follow-up after the redesign lands.

options.title: Pause both directions
options.body: Keep scheduled-first creation unchanged until maintainers choose a single Automations onboarding design.

recommendation.title: Fold into redesign
recommendation.body: Add create-only and create-and-run actions to the surviving creation form in the active Automations redesign and avoid maintaining two overlapping branches.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the paired issue and both overlapping product directions and have recent merged history in the affected UI.
